statement.text: Classify the smallest volume hyperbolic 3-manifolds of various types. In particular: (a) Determine the nonorientable closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds of least volume. (b) Determine the n-cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds of least volume for each $n\geq 3$. (c) Determine the smallest volume hyperbolic 3-manifolds with n orientable cusps for each n. (d) Determine the n-cusped orientable hyperbolic 3-manifolds of least volume for each n.
